learner_operation: Apply the product rule, replace y/x by v (and x/y by 1/v), simplify F(v)-v, and recognize an equivalent separated equation among five choices.

fixed_features.justification: The prompt explicitly requests this substitution; tutorial 4107 derives xv′=F(v)-v.

fixed_features.feature: One radio field with five equation choices
fixed_features.justification: Every supplied practice source uses this response contract; a target equation must be recognized, with no integration.

fixed_features.feature: Degree-zero homogeneous RHS and source-like nonlinear nesting/polynomial degrees
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 2106 defines homogeneity; restricting complexity preserves easy substitution and algebra workload.

answer_roles.role: Linear coefficient surviving subtraction of v
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Cancellation, negative and positive residual contributions; do not fix the surviving equation.
answer_roles.observed: Four nonzero shifts in each of eight identical complete banks select four different equations; zero shifts and three cancellation profiles also tested.

answer_roles.role: Coefficient or function-argument target inside cancellation bank
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Each available coefficient/argument can occupy the correct role within an unchanged five-equation window.
answer_roles.observed: Fresh seed 44219, window 2..6: five sec-argument targets and four nonsource sine/rational targets each; every tested target changes the correct choice.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Incidental to mathematics; seeds and actual UI order may vary.
answer_roles.observed: All five actual positions occur across 160 UI ordering contexts. Prompt math and key equation survive an irrelevant seed change.

coverage.result: Eight prompts, solutions, complete five-choice banks and keys replayed; 40 choices checked. Source copies are not treated as new inventory instances.
Every family: five shifts at k=5, domain endpoints at shift=2, plus seed controls. Independent visible mathematics and solutions passed.
13 fresh constant-window target assignments pass mathematics and delivery, with distinct keys in each unchanged bank.

All 5 survive actual filtering: four families, shifts -2,-1,0,+2; two exponential cases have different residuals/keys. Shortest, longest and lexicographically first choices each score 0/5; no fixed serialized position exceeds 2/5.
Seed 721097 produces 17 distinct mathematical prompts deterministically; all 17 pass delivery and independent math.

counterfactuals.change: Hold family and k=5 fixed; change shift -1 to +1, hence only +2y/x evidence changes.
counterfactuals.expected: Derived v′ increases by 2v/x; the correct equation changes in the identical visible bank. Worked equations and native grading must follow.
counterfactuals.observed: All eight families pass the independently parsed rate-delta and bank checks. All five alternatives are graded per instance. q-14316 and q-90600 pairs visually inspected in actual UI.
counterfactuals.justification: Product-rule derivation in tutorial 4107 makes the linear coefficient answer-bearing rather than an essential source assignment.

counterfactuals.change: Hold cancellation family, shift=0, and bank window 2..6 fixed; change k.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct equation must track the argument/coefficient, despite unchanged complete bank.
counterfactuals.observed: 13 fresh assignments produce distinct keys within each fixed bank, with displayed equations and native grading checked.
counterfactuals.justification: Sources q-8745, q-90601 and q-90600 cancel the product-rule v; the remaining sec argument or scalar factor still determines the result.

counterfactuals.change: Keep family,k,shift fixed and change seed 92831 to 184723.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt, worked solution and correct mathematical response stay identical; incidental option order may change.
counterfactuals.observed: All eight families preserve prompt, solution, bank and key value. Every option checked in native grader for both seeds; q-14316 pair visually inspected.
counterfactuals.justification: The source method depends on the differential equation and substitution, not on an RNG seed or option order.

stages_examined: generator finite-domain sampling and semantic task deduplication
actual publisher normalization, identity and captured-inventory/within-input deduplication
captured inventory and learner freshness exclusions
difficulty-first configured and unconfigured learner selection rules
delivery.result: Captured basis 5448. Runner 5->5; independent 72->56 (8 source replays and 8 irrelevant duplicates removed); fresh 17->17; cancellation 13->13. Fixed-bank decision variation remains after filtering. All records are easy, so a positive easy weight selects uniformly among fresh easy candidates; no template-specific selection exclusion. Unconfigured policy chooses first eligible entity and was examined separately.

limitations: Finite samples and fixed-bank arguments do not prove absence of every prompt-based shortcut.

Captured bank contains eight original source records and no generated records. All were independently checked; affected-inventory.json is empty for demonstrated generated defects, not a claim that original source banks lack recognizable distractor cues. Source status is preserved.
Live policy, learner histories, reservations and later inventory are unavailable; read-only selection analysis states explicit test contexts and does not claim an actual learner session.
UI rendering covers eleven representative records and desktop layout; no diagrams occur in the target questions.
